question: Feature-flag vendors are metered by feature flags, projects, environments, seats, MAUs, config downloads and audit-log retention; the free_tier.unit and limits[].kind vocabularies have no exact term for these object counts, so mixed and per-object-cap or volume-quota are used with the true unit named in the record text. Should specific terms be added?
why: No schema term exists for flags, projects, environments, seats, MAUs or config downloads; forcing them into request-count or bytes would misstate the binding constraint.

new.slice: Feature-flag vendors are metered by feature flags, projects, environments, seats
